title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #17 (Term 2)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is spiritual purity? (1 mark)
   A. Washing clothes
   B. Sweeping the room
   C. Washing hands
   D. Cleaning the heart from envy and pride

2. What is a mughalladha najasa? (1 mark)
   A. A medium najasa
   B. A light najasa
   C. A heavy najasa
   D. A prayer

3. How many times do we usually wash each part in wudhu? (1 mark)
   A. Once only for all
   B. Ten
   C. Three
   D. Twenty

4. Which body part is wiped, not washed? (1 mark)
   A. Face
   B. Head
   C. Arms
   D. Hands

5. What must a boy cover at the least during prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Only the face
   B. Nothing
   C. From navel to knees
   D. Only the feet

6. Which prayer is right after sunset? (1 mark)
   A. Asr
   B. Fajr
   C. Maghrib
   D. Dhuhr

7. If you stretch your right arm toward the sunrise, you are facing roughly (1 mark)
   A. South
   B. West
   C. East
   D. North

8. What do we say when sitting between the two sujud? (1 mark)
   A. Amin
   B. Bismillah
   C. Rabbighfir li
   D. La ilaha

9. When is the last tashahhud recited? (1 mark)
   A. In ruku
   B. In the first rak'ah
   C. In sujud
   D. In the final sitting

10. How are the postures of swalah good for health? (1 mark)
   A. They harm the knees
   B. They cause sickness
   C. They stop movement
   D. They stretch and move the body

11. What is the tashahhud? (1 mark)
   A. The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   B. The call to prayer
   C. A bowing
   D. The niyyah

12. To which sides do we turn for taslim? (1 mark)
   A. Up
   B. Right, then left
   C. Only forward
   D. Backwards

13. What is "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Fear
   B. Pride
   C. Anger
   D. Mercy

14. The Prophet said those who show mercy will be shown mercy by (1 mark)
   A. The Most Merciful
   B. The teacher
   C. A friend
   D. The government

15. Which of these fits the Islamic code of dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Loose, clean and modest
   B. Torn on purpose
   C. Very tight
   D. See-through

16. What did the Prophet say about modesty? (1 mark)
   A. It is weakness
   B. It is a game
   C. It is only for girls
   D. It is part of faith

17. Which is a positive use of media? (1 mark)
   A. Watching harmful content
   B. Sharing rumours
   C. Learning a surah with a recording
   D. Bullying online

18. What did the Prophet say about speech? (1 mark)
   A. Say everything
   B. Say whatever
   C. Say what is good or keep silent
   D. Speak loudly

19. Which prophet ate from the work of his hands? (1 mark)
   A. Yunus
   B. Nuh
   C. Dawud
   D. Hud

20. Which of these is a skill that can bring honest income later? (1 mark)
   A. Lying
   B. Stealing
   C. Tailoring
   D. Cheating

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. What is a pillar of swalah? (2 marks)

22. List the steps of wudhu in order from the hands to the feet. (3 marks)

23. State three times when it is recommended to be in wudhu. (3 marks)

24. Write a media plan for a week for a Grade 4 child following Islamic manners. (5 marks)

25. Explain the lesson from the story of the man who gave a dog water. (3 marks)

26. Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud. (3 marks)

27. Explain what a Muslim child should do before sharing a message. (4 marks)

28. Explain the hadith "The upper hand is better than the lower hand". (3 marks)

29. State two creatures of Allah in your environment. (2 marks)

30. State two reasons why we wear clothes. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #17 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Cleaning the heart from envy and pride
   Repentance and good deeds purify the heart.

2. C — A heavy najasa
   Mughalladha means heavy.

3. C — Three
   The Sunnah is three times.

4. B — Head
   The head is wiped.

5. C — From navel to knees
   This is the minimum.

6. C — Maghrib
   Maghrib is after sunset.

7. D — North
   Right arm east means facing north.

8. C — Rabbighfir li
   My Lord, forgive me.

9. D — In the final sitting
   In the last sitting.

10. D — They stretch and move the body
   Regular movement keeps joints flexible.

11. A — The recitation in sitting that includes the testimony of faith
   It is recited in sitting.

12. B — Right, then left
   We greet to the right and left.

13. D — Mercy
   Rahmah means mercy.

14. A — The Most Merciful
   Recorded by Abu Dawud and At-Tirmidhi.

15. A — Loose, clean and modest
   Clothes should cover properly.

16. D — It is part of faith
   Recorded by Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

17. C — Learning a surah with a recording
   Media can teach.

18. C — Say what is good or keep silent
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

19. C — Dawud
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari.

20. C — Tailoring
   Tailoring is a skill.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: A part of the prayer which must be done for it to be valid.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for part and 1 mark for validity.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hands, mouth, nose, face, arms to elbows, wipe head and ears, feet to ankles.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each three steps in the right order.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: Before prayer, before touching the Qur'an, before sleeping, before reciting Qur'an.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Screen time limit after homework; no screens at prayer or meal times; educational and Islamic content; ask permission; tell an adult if unsafe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid item up to 5.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: A small act of kindness can earn Allah's forgiveness and reward, and there is reward in serving every living creature.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for kindness, 1 mark for forgiveness, 1 mark for all creatures.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Check whether it is true and kind, and useful and safe. If not sure, do not share, as Qur'an 49:6 says to verify news.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for true, 1 mark for kind, 1 mark for useful or safe, 1 mark for the verse or verifying.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: The giving hand is better than the receiving hand. A Muslim should try to work and give rather than depend on others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for giver better, 1 mark for work, 1 mark for the lesson.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two, for example a cow and a bird.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: To cover the body, to protect us from weather, and to look neat and dignified.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
